For each candidate gathering floe use its arrival node as sink, rebuild residual capacities, and require flow equal to all penguins.

Finite differences characterize the unique lowest-degree interpolating polynomial. Record each difference row final value and extend by summing upward, preserving exact integer arithmetic even when polynomial coefficients are fractional.

The deterministic state is the ordered pair of current speaker and recipient, not a single person. Detect repeated pairs and reduce the requested step by the cycle length, outputting the speaker with correct one-based indexing.

Build the full0/1 subset-sum generating polynomial modulo10. For each lost item, divide out its factor(1+z^w) coefficientwise: remaining[x]=full[x]-remaining[x-w], processing upward. Equal-weight items remain distinct.

BothOR andXOR are bounded by the all-ones mask throughn highest bit. Choosing the highest power of2 at mostn and one less than that power attains this bound in both terms, with both operands positive because n>=2.

DP maximizes burgers for every exactly achievable duration. Select the greatest achievable time first to minimize waste, then its maximum count, matching the stated priority and omitting a zero-waste field.
